YOUR LOCAL LOCKSMITH

Frequently asked questions

Answers about emergency locksmith help, lock changes, door repairs, local coverage and sending an enquiry. Call directly if you are locked out now.

Call 0203 7720564Send an enquiry
Do you offer emergency help outside normal hours?

Emergency door opening is available 24/7. Call directly to check current availability and get an arrival estimate.

Can you open a door without damaging it?

Non-destructive entry is considered first. The lock’s condition determines what is possible, and the locksmith explains any work needed before starting.

Which areas do you cover?

We cover Epsom, Ewell West, Worcester Park and Stoneleigh. Give your postcode when calling so the locksmith can confirm availability for your address.

Should I change the locks after moving home?

A lock change helps you control who has a working key. Tell us which entrances you want checked so suitable replacement options can be discussed.

Does a stiff uPVC handle mean I need a new door?

Not necessarily. Alignment, the handle or the locking mechanism may be responsible. An inspection establishes whether adjustment, parts or wider repairs are needed.

What should I include in an enquiry?

Include your postcode, a description of the fault and the type of door, window, vehicle or safe involved. You can attach one photo or short video up to 3 MB. Call directly for urgent help.

Can you help with any car key or safe?

Compatibility depends on the make, model and locking system. Share those details first so the locksmith can check what work is possible.

Should I book online if I am locked out now?

Call 0203 7720564 for urgent help. Website enquiries are intended for non-urgent work and do not confirm an emergency appointment.
